info.name: Jad Moharam - Services 3, 8 and 9
info.description: Run folders in order against the separate demo database or compatible team data. Set tokens from real login for final evidence; temporary development tokens are supported until Mohannad merges Users. No response examples are presented as execution evidence.

request.description: Admin creates a notification. Required: user_id, title, message, type and severity. Authorized services may instead use X-Service-Key. Invalid fields: 400; unknown recipient: 404.
Retrieve User Notifications. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.
Retrieve Specific Notification. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.
Mark Notification Read. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.
Search Notifications. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.
Admin or regular user creates an incident. Regular users can report only under their own identity. Creates status Open and server timestamp; existing asset and reporter are required.
Retrieve All Incidents. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.
Retrieve Specific Incident. Expected HTTP 200; requires the documented role and valid record ownership.

Admin assigns an active analyst. Requires Omar Audit Logging on 5005; 503 cancels assignment if audit authorization fails. Assignment queues a notification on 5008; warning means delivery is saved for retry.
